entries: {@i Choose A, B, or C:} (A) {@item Studded Leather Armor|XPHB}, {@item Longbow|XPHB}, 20 {@item Arrow|XPHB|Arrows}, {@item Quiver|XPHB}, {@item Rapier|XPHB}, {@item Component Pouch|XPHB}, {@item Diamond|XPHB} worth 50 GP, and 4 GP; or (B) 200 GP

entries.name: Magus
entries: {@i An Arcane Warrior Wielding Spell and Steel}

Magi are gifted warriors that blend martial prowess with mystical puissance. Wielding spell and steel in tandem, Magi can render their enemies vulnerable to their magic with a look and invoke sigils to enhance their offensive and defensive abilities. Leveraging these diverse strengths, Magi can overcome even the most powerful adversaries and challenging obstacles.

Every Magi belongs to an esoteric order that shapes their abilities, enhances their sigils, and expands their magical capabilities. These orders also inform or reflect a Magus' goals and reasons for adventuring. Some orders compel Magi to catalogue the magical wonders of the multiverse while others call on Magi to deliver harsh and unrepentant justice. Just as a Magus balances their martial talents with their magical abilities, they must also balance their personal aspirations with their order's goals.

classFeature.name: Esoteric Eye
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can observe a creature you can see. Until the end of your next turn, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on your Magus spell attacks against it and it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws against your Magus spells.

You can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once). You regain one expended use when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

classFeature.name: Spellcasting
entries: With disciplined rehearsal, you can wage war and cast spells by rote. See the core rules for the rules on spellcasting. The information below details how you use those rules with Magus spells, which appear in the Magus spell list later in the class's description.

entries.name: Cantrips
entries: You know two Magus cantrips of your choice. {@spell Chill Touch|XPHB} and {@spell Fire Bolt|XPHB} are recommended. Whenever you gain a Magus level, you can replace one of your cantrips from this feature with another Magus cantrip of your choice.
When you reach Magus levels 10 and 14, you learn another Magus cantrip of your choice, as shown in the Cantrips column of the Magus Features table.

entries.name: Spell Slots
entries: The Magus Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended spell slots when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Prepared Spells of Level 1+
entries: You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose two level 1 Magus spells. {@spell Chromatic Orb|XPHB} and {@spell Shield|XPHB} are recommended.

The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Magus levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Magus Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional Magus spells until the number of spells on your list matches the number in the Magus Features table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 5 Magus, your list of prepared spells can include six Magus spells of level 1 or 2 in any combination.

If another Magus feature gives you spells that you always have prepared, those spells don't count against the number of spells you can prepare with this feature, but those spells otherwise count as Magus spells for you.

entries.name: Changing Your Prepared Spells
entries: Whenever you gain a Magus level, you can replace one spell on your list with another Magus spell for which you have spell slots.

entries.name: Spellcasting Ability
entries: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your Magus spells.

classFeature.name: Weapon Mastery
entries: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as {@item Rapier|XPHB|Rapiers} and {@item Pistol|XPHB|Pistols}.

Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can change the kinds of weapons you chose. For example, you could switch to using the mastery properties of {@item Longbow|XPHB|Longbows} and {@item Longsword|XPHB|Longswords}.

classFeature.name: Fighting Style
entries: You gain a {@filter Fighting Style feat|feats|category=FS} of your choice. Instead of choosing one of those feats, you can choose the option below.

classFeature.name: Mystic Mark
entries: You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to imbue yourself with magical power and resilience. When you do, choose a Magus level 1+ spell you have prepared that has a casting time of an action or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, expend a spell slot equal to or higher than the spell level, and choose Force damage or a damage type dealt by the spell. You gain your choice of the Aegis or Enspell benefit.

entries.name: Aegis
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the chosen damage type.

entries.name: Enspell
entries: When you deal damage with a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can deal the chosen damage type instead of the normal damage type for the attack.

You can only benefit from one Aegis and one Enspell at a time. While you have an Aegis or Enspell, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to release and cast a spell chosen using this feature. Your Mystic Mark and its corresponding benefit end after 1 hour, or when you release the spell.

classFeature.name: Magus Subclass
entries: You gain a Magus subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Magus levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Magus level or lower.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Arcane Ability
entries: When you fail an ability check, you can imbue your effort with a magical might. You add a bonus to the ability check equal to your Intelligence modifier plus the highest level unexpended spell you have, potentially turning it into a success.

Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} unless you expend a spell slot (no action required) to restore your use of it.

classFeature.name: Sword and Sorcery
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action and it doesn't benefit from the Extra Attack feature, you can cast a {@filter Magus cantrip with a casting time of an action|spells|level=0|class=magus (tmc'24)|cast time=action} as part of the same action. When you take the {@action Magic|XPHB} action on your turn, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to make one weapon attack.

classFeature.name: Magical Recovery
entries: You can regain some of your magical energy by meditating on the Tapestry and its myriad threads. When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level equal to no more than half your Magus level (round up), and none of the slots can be level 6 or higher. For example, if you're a level 6 Magus, you can recover up to three levels' worth of spell slots, regaining either one level 3 spell slot, a level 2 and a level 1 spell slot, or three level 1 spell slots.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature
entries: You gain a feature from your Magus Subclass.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Rite of Return
entries: When your {@classFeature Mystic Mark|Magus|Magus2024|2} ends without you releasing the spell, you regain the expended spell slot. Additionally, you can end your {@classFeature Mystic Mark|Magus|Magus2024|2} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, regaining the expended spell slot.

classFeature.name: All-Seeing Eye
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} you can expend a use of your {@classFeature Esoteric Eye|Magus|Magus2024|1} to gain {@sense Truesight|XPHB} out to a distance of 60 feet for 10 minutes. During this time, you can use the {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} granted by your {@classFeature Esoteric Eye|Magus|Magus2024|1} without requiring or expending any uses.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

classFeature.name: Sigil Surge
entries: The benefits of your {@classFeature Mystic Mark|Magus|Magus2024|2} are improved.

entries.name: Aegis
entries: At the start of each of your turns, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the expended spell slot level plus your Intelligence modifier.

entries.name: Enspell
entries: When you deal damage with a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you deal an additional {@damage 1d6} damage of the chosen type.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature
entries: You gain a feature from your Magus Subclass.

classFeature.name: Sorcerous Shielding
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Choose one of the following damage types: Force, Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant. You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to that damage type. At the start of each of your turns, you can change the damage type affected by this feature to one of the other listed options.

entries.name: Spell Parry
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and spell attacks against you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Spell Surge
entries: In times of need you can surge with arcane power, grasping at magic typically beyond your ability. Choose one {@filter level 6 Magus spell|spells|level=6|class=magus (tmc'24)} as your surge spell. You can cast your surge spell once without expending a spell slot. When you do, you regain one spell slot of your choice that is 5th level or lower.
Once you cast your surge spell you must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can cast it in this way again.

classFeature.name: Epic Boon
entries: You gain an {@filter Epic Boon feat|feats|category=EB} or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. {@feat Boon of Spell Recall|XPHB} is recommended.

classFeature.name: Archmagus
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Ability Score Enhancement
entries: Choose Strength or Dexterity. Your Intelligence and the chosen ability score increase by 2, to a maximum of 23.

entries.name: Rapid Recovery
entries: You can use your Magical Recovery twice, regaining both uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature
entries: You gain a feature from your Magus Subclass.

subclassFeature.name: Amethyst Mark
entries: The effects of your mystic marks are enhanced by your greater understanding of the Arcane Order's esoteric knowledge. When you use your {@classFeature Mystic Mark|Magus|Magus2024|2} feature, a faint purple, crystalline aura surrounds you and you gain the following effects based on the benefit or benefits chosen.

entries.name: Aegis
entries: When a willing creature you can see within 30 feet of you is hit by an attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to swap places via teleportation. You suffer the effects of the attack instead of the creature and you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to damage dealt by the attack.

entries.name: Enspell
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can force it to make a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, the creature is teleported 10 feet horizontally in a direction of your choosing.

subclassFeature.name: Arcane Order
entries: {@i Defend the Arcane Architecture of the Multiverse}

The Arcane Order seeks to catalog the magical wonders of the multiverse and defend the Tapestry from existential threats. You travel the world with an eye out for lost artifacts, magical monuments, and mystic secrets. Although some in the Arcane Order collect such prizes in a quest for power, most do so out of intellectual curiosity or the desire to preserve such treasures for future generations.

subclassFeature.name: Arcane Order Magic
entries: You can use an {@item Arcane Focus|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your Magus spells.

In addition, your training in the Arcane Order ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Magus level specified in the Arcane Order Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Arcane Order Spells
rows: {@spell Demiplanar Pitch|Magus2024}, {@spell Shocking Grasp|XPHB}, {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB}, {@spell Magic Missile|XPHB}

subclassFeature.name: Mystic Insights
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Cantrips
entries: You know two cantrips of your choice from the Wizard spell list. These cantrips count as Magus cantrips for you but don't count against your number of cantrips known.

entries.name: Arcana Adept
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Arcana|XPHB} skill. If you are already proficient with {@skill Arcana|XPHB}, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in it instead.

entries.name: Eldritch Eye
entries: You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to cast the {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB} spell or the {@spell Identify|XPHB} spell. You can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Lesser Spell Surge
entries: You can cast a Magus spell you have prepared without expending a spell slot, as if you had expended your highest level spell slot. Once you do, you cannot do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Occult Savant
entries: Choose two spells of a level you can cast from the Wizard spell list. You always have the chosen spells prepared. Whenever you gain a Magus level, you can replace one of the chosen spells with another spell from the Wizard spell list of a level you can cast.

subclassFeature.name: Arcane Vortex
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, choose a point you can see within 60 feet of yourself, warping space in a 20-foot radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} around it. You and your allies within the area can each teleport up to 30 feet in a direction of your choice. All other creatures in the area must make a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 6d8} Force damage, is pulled up to 15 feet closer to the point, and can't use its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} to move away from that point until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Master of the Arcane
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Amethyst Spell Surge
entries: You can expend the use of your {@classFeature Spell Surge|Magus|Magus2024|18} to cast {@spell Chain Lightning|XPHB} or {@spell Contingency|XPHB}.

entries.name: Vexing Vortices
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can regain the use of your {@subclassFeature Arcane Vortex|Magus|Magus2024|Arcane Order|Magus2024|14}. Once you regain the use of it in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Alabaster Mark
entries: The effects of your mystic marks are enhanced by your greater understanding of the Heaven's Guard's esoteric knowledge. When you use your {@classFeature Mystic Mark|Magus|Magus2024|2} feature, a soft white and gold aura envelops you, and you gain the following effects based on the benefit or benefits chosen.

entries.name: Aegis
entries: When a willing creature you can see within 30 feet of you is hit by an attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to guard the creature until the start of your next turn. While the creature is guarded this way, attacks against it have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

entries.name: Enspell
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attacks against creatures other than you until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Heaven's Guard
entries: {@i Make Heaven a Place on Earth}

Legend has it that in a time before recorded history, an elite host of Celestial warriors forsook their immortality and the divine realms, becoming mortal to protect the holy people and places of the Material Plane. The story goes that these martyrs' legacy lives on in the Heaven's Guard, an order of Magi that act as bodyguards to the righteous and sentinels of hallowed temples. Whether or not such tales are true, Magi in the Heaven's Guard eagerly serve as living shields to their chosen charges by drawing their enemies' ire and healing what wounds their adversaries manage to inflict.

subclassFeature.name: Heaven's Guard Magic
entries: You can use a {@item Holy Symbol|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your Magus spells.

In addition, your training in the Heaven's Guard ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Magus level specified in the Heaven's Guard Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Heaven's Guard Spells
rows: {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB}, {@spell Give Life|Magus2024}, {@spell Guiding Bolt|XPHB}, {@spell Righteous Incitement|Magus2024}

subclassFeature.name: Heavensent
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Best Offense
entries: While you are using a {@item Shield|XPHB}, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with weapons and {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}.

entries.name: Gifted Healer
entries: When you cause a creature to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} with a spell or Magus feature, you can expend a {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die}, rolling it and adding the result to the total number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} restored.

entries.name: Heaven's Hand
entries: When you cast a Magus spell that deals damage, it can deal your choice of Radiant damage or its normal damage type.

subclassFeature.name: Guardian's Wings
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can fly up to twice your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. When you do, at the end of your turn creatures of your choice within 10 feet of you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Magus level plus your Intelligence modifier.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Cloak of Radiance
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} you can cloak another creature within 30 feet of you and that you can see in radiant light. The target gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 5d10} plus your Magus level. While a creature has any {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} granted by this feature, it has the benefits listed below. Once you have used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Brilliant
entries: Creatures that do not have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attacks against the target.

entries.name: Bright
entries: The target sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} out to 30 feet and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet.

entries.name: Buoyant
entries: The target can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of its turns to Fly up to 30 feet. If the creature does not land at the end of this movement, it falls to the ground without taking damage.

subclassFeature.name: Bright as Dawn
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Alabaster Spell Surge
entries: You can expend the use of your {@classFeature Spell Surge|Magus|Magus2024|18} to cast {@spell Heal|XPHB} or {@spell Sunbeam|XPHB}.

entries.name: Celestial Shieldbearer
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can regain the use of your {@subclassFeature Cloak of Radiance|Magus|Magus2024|Heaven's Guard|Magus2024|14}. Once you regain the use of it in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Doombringer
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Deathsight
entries: You know when creatures you can see are {@status Bloodied|XPHB}. In addition, you can see creatures with the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition if they are {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, and you do not suffer {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attacks against them as a result of the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Unnatural Vitality
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} you can expend a spell slot to regain expended {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} equal to twice the spell slot's level.

entries.name: Reaper's Reward
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can expend and roll a {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die}. You regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and deal additional Necrotic damage to the creature, equal to a roll of the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die}.

subclassFeature.name: Knights Stygian
entries: {@i Haunt the Unrighteous}

When corruption spreads across the world like an infected sore and ne'er-do-wells hold the keys to the kingdoms, the Knights Stygian offer a cure that is as complete as it is brutal. These Magi believe that the means justify the ends, channeling dark magic to avenge injustices and bring evil to heel.

subclassFeature.name: Knights Stygian Magic
entries: You can use a {@item Memento Mori|Magus2024} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your Magus spells.

In addition, your training in the Knights Stygian ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Magus level specified in the Knights Stygian Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Knights Stygian Spells
rows: {@spell Bitter Wind|Magus2024}, {@spell Hateful Haunting|Magus2024}, {@spell Grave Bolt|Magus2024}, {@spell Grave Grasp|Magus2024}

subclassFeature.name: Obsidian Mark
entries: The effects of your mystic marks are enhanced by your greater understanding of the Knights Stygian's esoteric knowledge. When you use your {@classFeature Mystic Mark|Magus|Magus2024|2} feature, you emit drifting motes of black ash and the acrid smell of decay, and you gain the following effects based on the benefit or benefits chosen.

entries.name: Aegis
entries: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is hit by an attack, you can force the attacker to make a Constitution saving throw as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}. On a failed save, the attacker takes Necrotic damage equal to half the damage of its attack.

entries.name: Enspell
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack with a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can deal an additional {@damage 1d4} Necrotic damage. If the target is {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, the additional damage increases to {@damage 2d4}.

subclassFeature.name: Face of Fear
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Dreadful Incantation
entries: When you cast a level 1+ Necromancy spell or a spell from your Knights Stygian Magic, you can choose one creature within 60 feet of you that can see you. That creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC, gaining the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn on a failed save.

entries.name: Fearless
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Mortal Terror
entries: Whenever you would deal Necrotic damage with a Magus spell or feature, you can deal your choice of Psychic or Necrotic damage.

subclassFeature.name: Open the Iron Gates
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} you can fling open the gates between life and death, filling the air with shadows and ash. When you do, you manifest a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that originates from you for the next minute.

When a creature starts its turn in your {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, you can deal {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage to it. If the creature is {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, you can deal {@damage 3d6} Necrotic damage instead. In addition, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to make a creature of your choice within your {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that is {@status Bloodied|XPHB} take a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Darkest Knight
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Obsidian Spell Surge
entries: You can expend the use of your {@classFeature Spell Surge|Magus|Magus2024|18} to cast {@spell Circle of Death|XPHB} or {@spell Create Undead|XPHB}.

entries.name: Stygian Sentinel
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can regain the use of your {@subclassFeature Open the Iron Gates|Magus|Magus2024|Knights Stygian|Magus2024|14}. Once you regain the use of it in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Hand and Foot Training
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Covert Warrior
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Stealth|XPHB} skill and with {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB}. If you are already proficient with {@skill Stealth|XPHB}, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in it instead.

entries.name: Enshadowed Equipment
entries: You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to cause one of the following objects to magically coalesce from shadows in your hands: {@item Caltrops|XPHB}, {@item Costume|XPHB}, {@item Crowbar|XPHB}, {@item Grappling Hook|XPHB}, {@item Ladder|XPHB}, {@item Net|XPHB}, {@item Parchment|XPHB}, {@item Rope|XPHB}, {@item Signal Whistle|XPHB}, {@item Spyglass|XPHB}, or {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB}. This item remains until it has been exposed to {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} for 10 minutes, you dismiss it (no action required), or you use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} again.

You can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Martial Artist
entries: You can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier for the attack and damage rolls of your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}, and you can roll {@dice 1d6} in place of the normal damage of your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}. In addition, when you use the Grapple or Shove option of your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier to determine the save DC.

subclassFeature.name: Jade Mark
entries: The effects of your mystic marks are enhanced by your greater understanding of the Shadow Court's esoteric knowledge. When you use your {@classFeature Mystic Mark|Magus|Magus2024|2} feature, you are engulfed in an aura of translucent smoke and you gain the following effects based on the benefit or benefits chosen.

entries.name: Aegis
entries: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is hit by an attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to give the creature the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. The condition ends early if the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.

entries.name: Enspell
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can make the target overexposed until the start of your next turn or until it is hit with a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. While overexposed, attack rolls against the target can score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 19 or 20.

subclassFeature.name: Shadow Court
entries: {@i Fight for Control from the Shadows}

Although outsiders see the Shadow Court as a singular group, it is in fact multiple clans that wage clandestine wars against one another to obtain secrets and access to resources. Magi in the Shadow Court specialize in legerdemain, stealth, and assassination. Using these tools, these Magi manipulate political powers to stymie their enemies and advance their own agendas.

subclassFeature.name: Shadow Court Magic
entries: You can use {@item Parchment|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your Magus spells. When you do, if the spell is level 1+ the {@item Parchment|XPHB} is destroyed.

In addition, your training in the Shadow Court ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Magus level specified in the Shadow Court Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Shadow Court Spells
rows: {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB}, {@spell Forced Hesitation|Magus2024}, {@spell Phantasmal Feint|Magus2024}, {@spell Obscuring Prick|Magus2024}

subclassFeature.name: Broken Mirror Jutsu
entries: You always have the {@spell Mirror Image|XPHB} spell prepared.

You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to cast {@spell Mirror Image|XPHB} without expending a spell slot. When you do, each time a duplicate is destroyed the attacking creature must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw against your Magus spell save DC or take Psychic damage equal to your Magus level plus your Intelligence modifier.

Once you use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} unless you expend a level 2+ spell slot (no action required) to restore your use of it.

subclassFeature.name: False Body Jutsu
entries: You can replace yourself with an unlikely body double in the instant before you take a blow. When you are hit by an attack, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reduce the damage from that attack to 1. When you do, you have the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition for 1 minute and teleport to an unoccupied space of your choice within 300 feet of you. You leave a block of wood or another harmless, mundane object in the space you teleported away from.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Enshadowed Sifu
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Jade Spell Surge
entries: You can expend the use of your {@classFeature Spell Surge|Magus|Magus2024|18} to cast {@spell Eyebite|XPHB} or {@spell Programmed Illusion|XPHB}.

entries.name: Shadow Puppeteer
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can regain the use of your {@subclassFeature False Body Jutsu|Magus|Magus2024|Shadow Court|Magus2024|14}. Once you regain the use of it in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Selenite Mark
entries: The effects of your mystic marks are enhanced by your greater understanding of the Sidereal Cabal's esoteric knowledge. When you use your {@classFeature Mystic Mark|Magus|Magus2024|2} feature, you give off a soft indistinct multicolored glow and hum with potential energy. You gain the following effects based on the benefit or benefits chosen.

entries.name: Aegis
entries: When a willing creature you can see within 30 feet of you is hit by an attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make the attacker reroll the attack with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. It must use the new result.

entries.name: Enspell
entries: Once per turn when you miss a creature with a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can make the attack roll again with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. You must use the new result.

subclassFeature.name: Sidereal Cabal
entries: {@i Master Your Destiny (and Everyone Else's Too)}

Magi in the Sidereal Cabal consult the stars to foresee the future and intercede at moments of particular import. Long ago the cabal followed a philosophy of balance, believing that destiny and free will should be given equal weight. Today the cabal is split into two camps, kismetists and volitionists. Kismetists prefer indirect and discreet methods, believing that active and obvious interference in the world's affairs cause a disruption in the natural order of fate. Volitionists find pivotal moments where the road of destiny forks and interject themselves to force the outcome they prefer.

subclassFeature.name: Sidereal Cabal Magic
entries: You can use an {@item Astrolabe|Magus2024} or {@item Arcane Focus|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your Magus spells.

In addition, your training in the Sidereal Cabal ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Magus level specified in the Sidereal Cabal Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

subclassFeature.name: Starlit Sight
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} when you gain this feature, its range increases by 60 feet.

entries.name: Mini-Portent
entries: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, roll one {@dice d20} and record the number rolled. You can replace any {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} made by you or a creature that you can see with this foretold roll. You must choose to do so before the roll. This foretold roll can be used only once. When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you lose any unused foretold roll.

entries.name: Revelator's Eyes
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Perception|XPHB} skill. If you are already proficient with {@skill Perception|XPHB}, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in it instead.

subclassFeature.name: Celestial Clockwork Control
entries: Your extensive study of the stars has taught you to twist the heavenly mechanics of fate in your favor. After a creature you can see within 60 feet of you makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} you can expend a spell slot to modify the result of the roll. When you do, you can choose to increase or decrease the result of the roll by the level of the expended spell slot, potentially turning a failure into a success or vice versa.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Seal Fate
entries: When a creature that you can see within 60 feet makes a roll with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} or {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, you can seal its fate. The creature rolls three {@dice d20}s, rather than two, using the highest result if it had {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} or the lowest result if it had {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Starfinder
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Selenite Spell Surge
entries: You can expend the use of your {@classFeature Spell Surge|Magus|Magus2024|18} to cast {@spell First Speech|Magus2024} or {@spell True Seeing|XPHB}.

entries.name: Weave Destiny
entries: You can use your {@subclassFeature Seal Fate|Magus|Magus2024|Sidereal Cabal|Magus2024|14} three times, regaining one use when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} and all uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Agrestal Spirit
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Cantrips
entries: You know two additional cantrips of your choice from the Magus or Druid spell list. These cantrips count as Magus cantrips for you but don't count against your number of cantrips known.

entries.name: Green Hand
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Nature|XPHB} skill. If you are already proficient with {@skill Nature|XPHB}, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in it instead.

entries.name: Wild Instincts
entries: You can take the {@action Disengage|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. When you do, until the end of your turn your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 15 feet and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) and Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) checks.

You can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Emerald Mark
entries: The effects of your mystic marks are enhanced by your greater understanding of the Sylvan Circle's esoteric knowledge. When you use your {@classFeature Mystic Mark|Magus|Magus2024|2} feature, a verdant green aura surrounds you and you gain the following effects based on the benefit or benefits chosen.

entries.name: Aegis
entries: When you or a willing creature you can see within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to give the roll a bonus equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1), potentially turning the failure into a success.

entries.name: Enspell
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can cause the target to treat all spaces as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} until the end of its next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Sylvan Circle
entries: {@i Protect Wild Creatures and Natural Wonders}

The Sylvan Circle acts as the sword and shield of the natural world. You adventure to ensure that the world's natural wonders are preserved and that the diversity of its flora and fauna are not threatened. Although some Sylvan Circle Magi become hardliners that see themselves at war with civilization, most work to strike a balance between the needs of the natural world and the multiverse's various peoples.

subclassFeature.name: Sylvan Circle Spells
entries: You can use a {@item Druidic Focus|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your Magus spells.

In addition, your training in the Sylvan Circle ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Magus level specified in the Sylvan Circle Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Sylvan Circle Spells
rows: {@spell Entangle|XPHB}, {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB}, {@spell Thorn Whip|XPHB}, {@spell Thornhold|Magus2024}

subclassFeature.name: Nature's Mask
entries: You always have the {@spell Polymorph|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast the spell on yourself without expending a spell slot, when you do, the spell does not require {@status Concentration|XPHB} and its duration changes to 8 hours. You can end the spell at any point prior to the end of its duration (no action required).
Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Font of Life
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can manifest sylvan energies in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that originates from you for 1 minute. It ends early if you dismiss it (no action required) or have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

When you manifest the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} and at the start of each of your subsequent turns, creatures of your choice within your {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d8} plus your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one). Additionally, creatures of your choice within your {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws.
Once you use this feature, you must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can do so again.

subclassFeature.name: Sylvan Savant
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Emerald Spell Surge
entries: You can expend the use of your {@classFeature Spell Surge|Magus|Magus2024|18} to cast {@spell Conjure Fey|XPHB} or {@spell Wall of Thorns|XPHB}.

entries.name: Font Overflowing
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can regain the use of your {@subclassFeature Font of Life|Magus|Magus2024|Sylvan Circle|Magus2024|14}. Once you regain the use of it in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Mystic Warrior

otherSummary.entry: When Gaining the Level 2 Magus "Fighting Style" Feature

entries: You gain a bonus on Constitution saving throws you make to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1). When you fail a Constitution saving throw to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} on a spell, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to twice the spell's level plus your Intelligence modifier.

spell.name: Animate Shield
entries: You cause the {@item Shield|XPHB} used in this spell's casting to spring to life, flying of its own accord to defend you and your allies for the duration. The {@item Shield|XPHB} animates in an unoccupied space of your choice within range. While it is animated, the {@item Shield|XPHB} gives each creature of your choice within 5 feet of it a +2 bonus to AC if it is not wielding a {@item Shield|XPHB}. The animate shield is a Small Construct with an AC equal to 12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier, 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage and all conditions.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your later turns, you can cause the animate shield to fly up to 30 feet. This spell ends early if the animate shield is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The animate shield's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} increase by 10 for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Animate Weapon
entries: You cause the weapon used in this spell's casting to spring to life, flying of its own accord to harass and harm your enemies for the duration. The weapon animates in an unoccupied space of your choice within range. While it persists, at the start of each of your turns, the animate weapon makes one attack against a target of your choice within 5 feet (if it is a Melee weapon without the {@itemProperty R|XPHB|Reach} property), 10 feet (if it is a Melee weapon with the {@itemProperty R|XPHB|Reach} property), or the weapon's Range (if it is a Ranged weapon or Melee weapon with the {@itemProperty T|XPHB|Thrown} property). The weapon uses your spellcasting ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. The animate weapon is a Small Construct with an AC equal to 10 plus your spellcasting ability modifier, 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage and all conditions.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your later turns, you can cause the animate weapon to fly up to 30 feet. This spell ends early if the animate weapon is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The animate weapon's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} increase by 10 for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Arcane Invigoration
entries: You sacrifice your life force to weave a mystic defense. Roll one or two of your unexpended {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}, and gain a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the roll's total plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Those dice are then expended.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The number of unexpended {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} you can roll increases by one for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Assess Enemy
entries: You divine the strengths and weaknesses of a creature you can see within range. You immediately learn if the target is {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immune}, {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|Resistant}, or {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerable} to any damage types, and if so what types. In addition, for the duration you gain the following benefits:

items: You know if the target is {@status Bloodied|XPHB}.
Your attack rolls against the target score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 19 or 20 on the {@dice d20}.
When the target attacks you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to give the attack {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

spell.name: Baffle
entries: You cause a creature to temporarily forget everything they've ever learned. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, it takes {@damage 1d4} Psychic damage and the first time it makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} before the end of your next turn it takes a penalty equal to its {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d4} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d4}), 11 ({@dice 3d4}), and 17 ({@dice 4d4}).

spell.name: Bitter Wind
entries: The chill of mortality rattles through a creature of your choice within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 1d8} Cold damage and lose all damage {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|Resistances} it has until the start of your next turn, or until it takes damage of a type it normally has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d8}), 11 ({@dice 3d8}), and 17 ({@dice 4d8}).

spell.name: Carrionette

time.condition: which you take when a creature you can see within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points or dies

entries: Ethereal strings spring from your fingers and wrap around the limbs of the triggering creature. If the creature is not a Construct or Undead, and doesn't have a {@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB} of 7+ ,it immediately dies if it is not already dead and, at the start of your next turn, you can instruct it where to move, choosing which of its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB|Speeds} to use (no action required). You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to issue a command for it to use an action of your choice from its stat block (except for casting a spell). This spell ends at the end of your turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The maximum {@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB} of a creature you can target with the spell increases by 3 for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Cascade of Hours
entries: Time slows to a crawl for you and you alone. You complete one task that you can complete within 8 hours and that doesn't require interacting with another creature, in a pocket outside of time, such as traveling across a city, crafting an item, or reading a book. The stress of being nearly outside the flow of time prevents you from taking a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} while in the temporal pocket.

spell.name: Caustic Claw
entries: You attempt to strike a creature within range, causing its vital components to turn caustic and self-destructive. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, you deal {@dice 1d4} Acid damage and the target must expend and roll a {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} if it has any. The target takes additional Poison damage equal to the result.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The Acid damage increases by {@dice 1d4} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d4}), 11 ({@dice 3d4}), and 17 ({@dice 4d4}).

spell.name: Demiplanar Pitch
entries: You thrust your hand into empty space in front of you and punch through to a demiplane housing the contents of a random {@item Bag of Holding|XDMG} somewhere in the multiverse, then launch whatever you can grab at a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target, dealing {@damage 1d8} Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage (your choice) on a hit. After you make the attack, the object teleports back to the demiplane it came from.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d8}), 11 ({@dice 3d8}), and 17 ({@dice 4d8}).

spell.name: Ensorcelled Strike
entries: As part of casting this spell, you make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} or attack with a weapon against a creature. On a hit, you deal damage as normal and the target is ensorcelled until the end of your next turn. While a creature is ensorcelled, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells, and spell attacks against it have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. A target is no longer ensorcelled if it fails a saving throw against a spell or is hit by a spell attack.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: If the spell slot is level 2+, the attack deals an additional {@damage 1d6} Force damage for each slot level above 1.

spell.name: First Speech
entries: When the Tapestry was woven, the first creatures could communicate with one another perfectly through a speech that has long since been lost to time. Though the mortal mind cannot master such speech, you can temporarily learn it using this spell. For the duration you gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with all creatures and plants, and whenever you make a Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}, {@skill Intimidation|XPHB}, or {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) check, you gain a bonus to the check equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of +1).

spell.name: Forced Hesitation

time.condition: which you take when a creature you can see within range makes an Initiative roll

entries: You tug on the threads of a creature's awareness at a pivotal moment. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take {@damage 3d4} Psychic damage, and its {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} roll is reduced by the highest result of the damage dice.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d4} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Give Life
entries: By placing your hand on another creature, you transfer your life force to them. You expend and roll one of your {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}. The target regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the result of the roll.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: You can expend and roll an additional {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} when you reach levels 5 (2 total), 11 (3 total), and 17 (4 total).

spell.name: Grave Bolt

components.m: a vial of fetid swamp mud

entries: Negative energy crackles around your hand then shoots in a jagged black bolt from your outstretched fingers to a target of your choice that you can see within range. An Undead creature targeted by this spell regains {@dice 1d8} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, otherwise the target takes {@damage 1d8} Necrotic damage. A Humanoid creature who dies as a result of taking damage from this spell immediately transforms into a {@creature Zombie|XMM} and acts at the start of the next round.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} regained or damage dealt increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Grave Grasp
entries: You cause putrefied hands to burst out of the ground or another surface within range, grasping at a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. While a creature has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition from this spell, it can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. The target, or another creature within 5 feet of the target, can use its action to free the target, ending the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Hateful Haunting
entries: Choose a creature within range who doesn't have the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition. The target hears the voices of its deceased ancestors heaping scorn upon it and must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or take {@damage 1d4} Psychic damage, plus an additional {@damage 1d4} Psychic damage the first time it fails a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} before the end of its next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: Both the initial and additional damage increase by {@dice 1d4} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d4}), 11 ({@dice 3d4}), and 17 ({@dice 4d4}).

spell.name: Misfortunate Missile

components.m: a tuft of fur from a black cat

entries: Misfortune crystallizes into a physical force on your finger tips and launches where you direct it. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature you can see within range. On a hit, you deal {@damage 1d6} Force damage and before the start of your next turn, immediately after the target makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to roll {@dice 1d4} and subtract it from the triggering roll's result.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d6}), 11 ({@dice 3d6}), and 17 ({@dice 4d6}).

spell.name: Mortal Terror

components.m: the skull of a deceased Humanoid

entries: A creature of your choice within range that can see you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for the duration. While a creature has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition from this spell, it suffers the following effects:

items: When you deal damage to the target with an attack or spell, it takes an additional {@damage 1d4} Psychic damage.
If the target willingly moves more than half of its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} in a turn it must immediately succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.
The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks to notice actions, events, or creatures other than you.

entries: If the target cannot see you on its turn, it can use its action to make the saving throw again, ending the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Obscuring Prick
entries: A creature of your choice within range experiences a brief flash of pain in one of its eyes. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it takes {@damage 1d4} Piercing damage and the target cannot see you, as if it had the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition, until the start of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d4} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d4}), 11 ({@dice 3d4}), and 17 ({@dice 4d4}).

spell.name: Overexposure
entries: You cause a creature of your choice that you can see within range to shimmer with magical energy. When you do, the target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or take {@damage 1d6} Radiant damage and become overexposed until it takes a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} or until the start of your next turn. While overexposed, attack rolls against the target can score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 19 or 20.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d6}), 11 ({@dice 3d6}), and 17 ({@dice 4d6}).

spell.name: Phantasmal Feint
entries: You lash out with the toy used in this spell's casting. Make a melee spell attack against one creature of your choice within range. On a hit, you deal {@damage 1d6} Psychic damage and the next attack with a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} against the target before the start of your next turn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d6}), 11 ({@dice 3d6}), and 17 ({@dice 4d6}).

spell.name: Provoke
entries: A creature within range that doesn't have the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Deafened|XPHB} conditions is provoked by you for the duration of the spell. While provoked, the creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against creatures other than you.

In addition, when the provoked creature attacks a creature other than you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} or attack with a weapon against it. On a hit, you deal the attack's normal damage and an additional {@damage 1d6} Force damage.
The effect of this spell ends early on a target if it ends its turn more than 60 feet away from you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Reflect Magic

time.condition: which you take when you are targeted by, or within the area of, a spell

m.text: a polished silver mirror worth 100+ GP, which this spell consumes

entries: Shimmering interconnected hexagons momentarily appear around you, disrupting or redirecting a spell targeting you. The creature casting the spell makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a successful save, the spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, or {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} used to cast it is wasted. If the spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot is expended. On a failed save, you deflect the spell, choosing a new target, targets, or area for it as if you had cast the spell from your space. Once redirected, the spell is resolved as normal.

spell.name: Righteous Incitement
entries: You castigate a creature with words or a derisive strike. A creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 1d6} Radiant damage, and if it does not target you with an attack before the end of its next turn it takes an additional {@damage 1d6} Psychic damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: Both the initial and additional damage increase by {@dice 1d6} when you reach levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

spell.name: Spell Aegis
entries: You create a magical aegis with {@dice 3d8} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} in an unoccupied space within range. When a creature within 10 feet of the aegis takes Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder damage, you can choose for the aegis to take the damage instead. If this damage reduces the aegis to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the aegis is destroyed and the spell ends early. While this spell persists, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to move the aegis to another unoccupied space within 60 feet of you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The aegis's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} increase by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Strike Order
entries: You imbue your voice with supernatural authority and order a creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you to attack. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or immediately use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make an attack against a creature of your choice other than itself within the reach or normal range of an attack it can make. The target makes this save with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} if it is Immune to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition. The spell fails if the target is unable to take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} or if there is no viable creature for it to attack.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: If you use a spell slot of level 6+, the duration increases to "{@status Concentration|XPHB}, up to 1 minute", and you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your subsequent turns for the duration to rebear the spells' effect. When you do, you can target the same creature or a different one within range.

spell.name: Stygian Blast
entries: A black speck of dust floats to a point you choose within range before erupting with necrotic energy. Each Undead in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centred on that point regains {@dice 3d8} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Other creatures and objects within the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} must make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 6d8} Necrotic damage on a failed save. A Humanoid killed by this spell transforms into a {@creature Zombie|XMM} which immediately acts at the start of the next round, and is hostile to all creatures, including you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage and healing both increase by {@dice 1d8} for every spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Thornhold
entries: Phantasmal vines covered in thorns encircle you. You gain {@dice 1d4} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. If a creature deals damage with a melee attack that causes you to lose {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} gained by this spell, it takes Piercing damage equal to the number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} lost. You lose any remaining {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} granted by this spell at the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} granted increase by {@dice 1d4} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d4}), 11 ({@dice 3d4}), and 17 ({@dice 4d4}).

spell.name: Towerfall Tactic

time.condition: which you take when you take damage from an attack

entries: You gain 5 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} and the creature that made the triggering attack must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, the creature gains the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition and it cannot right itself to end the condition until after the end of the current turn. These {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} vanish if any remain after 1 minute.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Warrior's Way
entries: You magically channel the martial wisdom of the multiverse's warriors. For the duration, you can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can attack three times instead of once whenever you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn with a level 5+ spell slot.

spell.name: Waypoint

components.m: a spool of thread or loaf of bread

entries: When you cast this spell you place an {@condition invisible} mystic mark on the spot where you are standing, tethering yourself to it for the duration. During this time you can perform a 1 minute ritual to teleport yourself and a number of willing creatures equal to 1 plus your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of 1) that you can see within 10 feet of you back to that spot. If the exact space is currently occupied by a creature or object you instead teleport to the nearest unoccupied space. Once you perform this ritual, this spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The duration increases with a spell slot of level 5-6 (24 hours), and 7+ (10 days).

spell.name: Weapon Aegis
entries: You create a magical aegis with {@dice 3d8} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} in an unoccupied space within range. When a creature within 10 feet of the aegis takes Bludgeoning, Piercing, Poison, or Slashing damage, you can choose for the aegis to take the damage instead. If this damage reduces the aegis to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the aegis is destroyed and the spell ends early. While this spell persists, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to move the aegis to another unoccupied space within 60 feet of you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The aegis's hit points increase by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 1.

item.name: Adamant Scale
entries: When you cast the {@spell Mage Armor|XPHB} spell, you can consume this magic item. When you do, the base AC granted by the spell is 15 plus its Dexterity modifier and any Critical Hits against the target become normal hits for the spell's duration.

item.name: Astrolabe
entries: An Astrolabe is a small instrument made of metal that can be used as a star chart and an instrument that can be used to solve a variety of problems related to astronomy and navigation.

item.name: Distorted Hourglass
entries: When you cast the {@spell Haste|XPHB} or {@spell Slow|XPHB} spell, you can consume this magic item. When you do, you cast both the {@spell Haste|XPHB} and {@spell Slow|XPHB} spells, but only need to concentrate on one spell. If you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB}, both spells immediately end.

item.name: Dragon's Wingscale
entries: When you cast the {@spell Dragon's Breath|XPHB} spell, you can consume this magic item. When you do, the spell's target gains a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 30 feet for the duration of the spell.

item.name: Gilded Pate
entries: This gold covered skull can be used as a {@item Memento Mori|Magus2024}.
When you use this magic item as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for a spell, you can apply one of the following effects.

entries.name: Channel the Beyond
entries: If the spell deals damage, you can change the damage type of the spell to your choice of Necrotic or Radiant damage.

entries.name: Enspelled Terror
entries: If the spell is level 1+, one target of the spell must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC, or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

item.name: Grimoire of Stolen Secrets
entries: This black leather tome is blank until imbued with Spell Scrolls. When you tuck a {@item Spell Scroll|XDMG} into the grimoire and leave it untouched for 8 hours, the {@item Spell Scroll|XDMG} is destroyed as if it had been used and the spell can now be found in the grimoire.
All spells in this grimoire are prepared by you and added to each of your classes' spell lists. The grimoire can contain a total of 5 spells with no spell being level 6+.
Once your {@variantrule Attunement|XPHB} on this magic item ends, the pages return to being blank.

item.name: Humanoid Skull
entries: A Memento Mori is a physical remnant of a deceased humanoid typically used as a trophy, to honor the dead, or for some other occult purpose. Spiritualists, Knights Stygian, and Necrodancers can use such an item as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}.

item.name: Iron Feather
entries: When you cast the {@spell Forced Hesitation|Magus2024} spell, you can consume this magic item. When you do, if the target fails its saving throw, its {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} roll is reduced by the two highest results of the damage dice combined.

item.name: Jade Toadstool
entries: When you cast the {@spell Revivify|XPHB} spell, you can consume this magic item instead of a diamond worth 300+ GP. When you do, the target creature revives with {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum instead of 1.

item.name: Leaden Mirror
entries: When you cast the {@spell Counterspell|XPHB} spell and the target of the spell fails its saving throw, you can consume this magic item. When you do, if the target fails its saving throw, it loses any spell slot used to cast the spell, and takes {@damage 1d6} Force damage per level of the spell.

item.name: Magic Magnifier
entries: When you cast the {@spell Ensorcelled Strike|Magus2024} spell, you can consume this magic item. When you do, if you hit the target with the attack, the first time it takes damage from a spell before the end of your next turn it takes an additional {@damage 3d6} Force damage.

item.name: Magiceramic Mask
entries: When you cast the {@spell Nystul's Magic Aura|XPHB} spell, you can consume this magic item. When you do, you can target an unwilling creature with the spell. The creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC or suffer the Mask effect of the spell for the duration.

item.name: Miniature Multiverse Model
entries: This mithril-detailed model of the cosmos can be used as an {@item Astrolabe|Magus2024}. When you use this object as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your spells.

In addition, when a creature you can see within 60 feet of you makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can give that {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} your choice of {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} or {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}.

item.name: Necklace of Fangs
entries: This necklace of vampire and werebeast teeth can be used as a {@item Memento Mori|Magus2024}.

This necklace has 6 charges. While wearing the necklace, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to expend 1 charge from the object and choose a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. That creature must make a Dexterity saving throw (save DC 13) taking {@damage 6d6} Piercing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. You regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the amount of Piercing damage dealt.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The necklace regains {@dice 1d6} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the necklace melts into black slag leaving permanent bite marks around your throat and shoulders.

item.name: Necklace of Teeth
entries: A Memento Mori is a physical remnant of a deceased humanoid typically used as a trophy, to honor the dead, or for some other occult purpose. Spiritualists, Knights Stygian, and Necrodancers can use such an item as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}.

item.name: Pickled Pixie Heart
entries: This small glass vial containing a sickly green liquid and the preserved heart of a fairy can be used as a {@item Memento Mori|Magus2024}.

This vial has 5 charges. While holding the vial, you can expend 1 charge to cast {@spell Misty Step|XPHB}. When you do, each creature of your choice within 5 feet of the space you left must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (save DC 14) or have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The object regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the object's last charge, roll {@dice 1d10}. On a 1, the object dissipates into a bubbling sulphuric goo.

item.name: Polychromatic Prism
entries: When you cast the {@spell Chromatic Orb|XPHB} spell, you can consume this magic item. When you do, you can choose Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage instead of the damage types listed in the spell's description, and the spell deals an additional {@damage 2d8} damage.

item.name: Preserved Organ in a Jar
entries: A Memento Mori is a physical remnant of a deceased humanoid typically used as a trophy, to honor the dead, or for some other occult purpose. Spiritualists, Knights Stygian, and Necrodancers can use such an item as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}.

item.name: Restless Cremains
entries: This trembling silver vial of humanoid cremains can be used as a {@item Memento Mori|Magus2024}.

This vial has 9 charges. Whenever you cast a spell using the vial as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}, you can expend a number of charges up to the level of spell cast. For each charge expended, you summon a Dust Mephit to an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet.

Each of the mephits understand your languages, obey your commands, are {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} to you and your allies, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count. If you issue no commands, the creature defends itself but takes no other actions. Each mephit summoned by this vial dissipates into dust and returns to the vial when it is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or after 10 minutes.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The object regains {@dice 1d6 + 3} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the object's last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the vial crumbles into dust and is destroyed.

item.name: Ruby Toadstool
entries: When you cast the {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|XPHB} spell, you can consume this magic item. When you do, the target's size increases by two categories instead of one and whenever the spell would require the target to roll {@dice 1d4}, they roll {@dice 1d8} instead.

item.name: Scythe of Grim Harvest
entries: This item appears to be a two-handed scythe, and can be used as a {@item Memento Mori|Magus2024}.

entries.name: Bloody Hungry
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attacks against {@status Bloodied|XPHB} creatures.

entries.name: Harvest Soul
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of you is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, you can gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to its {@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB} or level, and make one attack with a weapon.

entries.name: Sweeping Shear
entries: As an action, you can force creatures of your choice within 10 feet of you to make a Dexterity saving throw (save DC 13). A creature takes Slashing damage equal to {@dice 3d6} plus your level on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

item.name: Starfall Spotter
entries: This gold and silver model of the stars can be used as an {@item Astrolabe|Magus2024}.

This object has 12 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast {@spell Magic Missile|XPHB} or 4 charges to cast {@spell Fireball|XPHB} (save DC 15) from it. When you cast either spell from this object, the damage type of the spell is Radiant, rather than its normal damage type.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The object regains {@dice 2d6} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the object's last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the object disappears in a streaking flash of light.

item.name: Tiny Mithril Hammer
entries: When you cast the {@spell Magic Weapon|XPHB} spell, you can consume this magic item. When you do, the duration changes to 8 hours.

item.name: Witchwood Jaw
entries: When you cast the {@spell Animate Dead|XPHB} spell, you can consume this magic item. When you do, the {@creature Skeleton|XMM|Skeletons} and {@creature Zombie|XMM|Zombies} created through the spell can speak and understand any languages you know.

itemGroup.name: Memento Mori
entries: A Memento Mori is a physical remnant of a deceased humanoid typically used as a trophy, to honor the dead, or for some other occult purpose. Spiritualists, Knights Stygian, and Necrodancers can use such an item as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}.
